title: COMPARISON OF 5-YEAR CUMULATIVE TOTAL RETURN Among Apple Inc., the S&P 500 Index and the Dow Jones U.S. Technology Supersector Index
series: Dow Jones U.S. Technology Supersector Index
description: The chart displays the cumulative total return of Apple Inc. compared to the S&P 500 Index and the Dow Jones U.S. Technology Supersector Index over a five-year period. Apple Inc. consistently shows the highest total return, starting at approximately $100 and ending around $430. The S&P 500 Index also demonstrates growth, reaching approximately $210 by the end of the period, while the Dow Jones U.S. Technology Supersector Index shows the lowest return, ending at approximately $200. All three entities began with an approximate value of $100 at the start of the period.
